mapper.sql: id, task_no, status, stage, source_lang, target_lang, original_path, result_path, progress, error_message, retry_count, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_translation_task WHERE status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
SELECT status AS status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM tb_translation_task GROUP BY status ORDER BY cnt DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_translation_task SET status = 'SUCCESS', stage = 'COMPLETED', progress = 100, result_path = #{resultPath}, error_message = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE tb_translation_task SET status = 'FAILED', error_message = #{errorMessage}, retry_count = retry_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE tb_translation_task SET status = 'FAILED', error_message = '处理超时自动标记失败' WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND updated_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - (#{minutes} || ' minutes')::INTERVAL
